evidence.On foot/Left stick: p4 Default Controls: Move - left analog stick
evidence.On foot/L1: p4: Lock On Target/Next Target/Sniper Scope - L1 button
evidence.On foot/Right stick: p4: Look/Manual Aim Adjust - right analog stick
evidence.On foot/Square: p4: Punch Left/Right - Square button/Triangle button
evidence.On foot/Triangle: p4: Punch Left/Right - Square button/Triangle button
evidence.On foot/R2: p4: Wall Hug - R2 button; Turn Around (While Rappelling) - R2 button
evidence.On foot/Up/Down: p4: Sniper Zoom (When Looking Through Sniper Scope) - D-button up/down
evidence.Driving/Cross: p5 Driving Controls: Forward - Cross button/right analog stick up
evidence.Driving/Square: p5: Brake/Reverse - Square button/right analog stick down
evidence.Driving/Right stick: p5: Forward - right analog stick up; Brake/Reverse - right analog stick down; Raise/Lower Cannon (Tank Only) - right analog stick up/down; Rotate Cannon (Tank Only) - right analog stick left/right
evidence.Driving/Circle: p5: Handbrake - Circle button; 180-Degree Spin (Rail Mission only) - Circle button
evidence.Driving/Left stick: p5: Steer Left/Right - left analog stick left/right; Bond Movement (When Outside Vehicle) - left analog stick; Altitude (Helicopter Only) - left analog stick up/down
evidence.Driving/L1: p5: Activate Gadget - L1 button; Action Slide (Motorcycles Only) - L1 button; Self Destruct (RC Car Only) - L1 button
evidence.Driving/Triangle: p5: Enter/Exit Vehicle (Only in Designated Areas) - Triangle button; Context-Sensitive Action Button (When Outside Vehicle) - Triangle button
evidence.Driving/Circle+Cross: p5: Burnout (Motorcycle Only) - Circle button + Cross button
evidence.Driving/R3: p5: Center Turret (Non-Rail Tank Only) - R3 button
evidence.Driving/Select: p5: Toggle HUD Map - SELECT button
